kitty.script:
#!/bin/sh
# Hypr Studio (LabtosoStudios) – automatisch erzeugt, wird beim Anwenden überschrieben
command -v fastfetch >/dev/null 2>&1 && fastfetch
echo hi
sh_="${SHELL:-}"
case "$sh_" in ""|*hyprstudio-start.sh) sh_=$(getent passwd "$(id -un)" | cut -d: -f7) ;; esac
exec "${sh_:-/bin/sh}"

lock.conf:
# Hypr Studio (LabtosoStudios) – automatisch erzeugt, wird beim Anwenden überschrieben

general {
    hide_cursor = true
    grace = 0
    ignore_empty_input = true
}

background {
    monitor =
    path = screenshot
    color = rgba(1e1e2eff)
    blur_passes = 3
    blur_size = 7
    brightness = 0.80
    contrast = 0.90
    vibrancy = 0.17
}

label {
    monitor =
    text = $TIME
    color = rgba(c0caf5ff)
    font_size = 90
    font_family = JetBrainsMono Nerd Font
    position = 0, 90
    halign = center
    valign = center
}

label {
    monitor =
    text = cmd[update:60000] date +"%A, %d %B"
    color = rgba(c0caf5ff)
    font_size = 20
    font_family = JetBrainsMono Nerd Font
    position = 0, 6
    halign = center
    valign = center
}

label {
    monitor =
    text = Hi, $USER
    color = rgba(c0caf5ff)
    font_size = 16
    font_family = JetBrainsMono Nerd Font
    position = 0, -50
    halign = center
    valign = center
}

input-field {
    monitor =
    size = 300, 52
    outline_thickness = 3
    outer_color = rgba(7aa2f7ff)
    inner_color = rgba(1a1b26dd)
    font_color = rgba(c0caf5ff)
    font_family = JetBrainsMono Nerd Font
    check_color = rgba(e0af68ff)
    fail_color = rgba(f7768eff)
    rounding = 12
    placeholder_text = Password …
    fail_text = $FAIL ($ATTEMPTS)
    fade_on_empty = false
    dots_center = true
    dots_size = 0.25
    dots_spacing = 0.3
    position = 0, -120
    halign = center
    valign = center
}
